name: Gale
note: Gale, a Thunderstore mod manager. Its ProductName, "Gale" (productName in its src-tauri/tauri.conf.json), is too common a word to go by alone, so it is found with its exe's name, gale.exe, as its installer put it in Magic Kettle. The cover is Magic Kettle's own: the program's logo from its repository on a background in its colours, with its name. Without one its card showed only the small icon from the exe.
